Hi Jordan / Sasha 

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick post-call recap and proposed next steps so we can align on procurement readiness and the commercial path: 

Call recap (high level):
- Pilot scope: inference for search relevance (2M tokens/month expected initially).
- Technical: we'll run a sandbox on Dedicated for the pilot; security team asked for the questionnaire and network diagram.
- Commercial: Acme prefers a standard PO for pilot but wanted to confirm marketplace vs direct billing options.

Action items / asks for Acme:
1) Confirm preferred billing path: PO (net-30) vs corporate card vs AWS Marketplace listing. If PO, who is the finance contact (name + email) and any internal PO process notes?
2) Legal: will your legal review the MSA or do you need a short SOW first? If legal prefers SOW-first, please share required SOW fields.
3) Security: I'll attach the standard security questionnaire; please confirm who on your side will own the responses and estimated turnaround.
4) Timeline: can you share an internal timeline for legal -> security -> finance (PO issuance)? We can draft a mutual action plan with milestone dates.

I've attached the initial mutual action plan (MPA-v1.xlsx) for tracking. If it helps, we can provision a short 30-minute check-in next Tuesday to align stakeholders.

Proposed default timeline (we can adjust based on your inputs):
- Legal review: 10 business days from receipt of MSA/SOW
- Security questionnaire: 5 business days after receiving questionnaire
- Finance / PO issuance: 5 business days after legal & security sign-off

Next steps for us: I'll circulate the MSA draft and a redlined MPA once you confirm the billing path.

Thanks 

Best,

Jordan / Sasha / Amanda 

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the SOW requirements doc. Based on your inputs, here's a proposed mutual action plan and recommended commercial path to keep the pilot moving quickly. Please confirm or flag edits.

Proposed commercial path (recommended):
- Pilot: Direct PO (net-30) with short SOW attached. This aligns with your finance preference and is typically the fastest for pilots.
- Marketplace: AWS Marketplace is a good option for later-stage, regionally distributed procurement; we can start the Marketplace listing in parallel but it often takes longer to go live.

Draft timeline & milestones (target dates based on calendar):
- 7/10/2026: Redwood to send redlined MPA and draft SOW + MSA (attached).
- 7/10/2026: Acme to confirm finance contact and internal PO routing (Amanda).
- 7/13/2026: Acme legal to begin SOW review (expected 7-10 business days).
- 7/13/2026: Acme security to receive questionnaire and network diagram (expected 5-7 business days).
- 7/24/2026: Target date for legal + security sign-off (assuming no major issues).
- 7/27/2026: Finance to issue PO (5 business days post sign-off).
- 7/30/2026: Target pilot start date (provision Dedicated sandbox and onboarding).

Risks / dependencies:
- If legal requires significant MSA redlines, timeline may extend; we can accept a minimal SOW to speed review.
- Security clarifications (network/firewall rules) may require an infra call; Marcus can join to accelerate.

Immediate asks for Acme this week:
- Confirm Amanda.Reyes@acmecloud.com as finance contact and whether PO requires a specific invoice template.
- Confirm decision to proceed PO-first vs card/marketplace for the pilot.
- Identify the security questionnaire owner and expected completion date.

I attached the redwood_mpa_v1.xlsx with milestone dates filled in and a draft MSA (redwood_msa_draft.pdf). For convenience, here's a DocuSign link to a non-binding MSA draft (we can postpone signature until redlines are agreed): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/to/msa-draft

Would you be available for a 30-minute check-in on Monday 7/13 at 10:00 AM PT to walk legal/security through the SOW fields and align next steps? If so, I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks 

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
